# Viewpoint source for SAO's native project viewpoint

Source: [Project Viewpoint Workshop item 3809306528](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809306528)

Creators: ellu and norkus. Source release: `0.1.5a-hotfix`, Build 42.21. The bundled archive is the Workshop `42/media/java/client/Viewpoint.jar` acquired in the isolated SteamCMD intake recorded at `_scratch/d2-leisure-01/viewpoint21/ACQUISITION-20261008T003202Z.json`. Its SHA-256 is `94FEDDA302AB6C17BA1B38495789E4C9781D52823FB8204214C85402E3CAB41F`.

The operator represented direct permission from the rights holders to integrate this source into SAO. `LICENSE` preserves the source terms. SAO's `java/src/viewpoint/ModLua.java` adapts the source play-start Lua fallback to the SAO package layout. The other Viewpoint classes and shader resources are copied byte-for-byte from the pinned archive by `tools/build-java.sh`. SAO's `CREDITS.md` carries product attribution.
